# Snake Skiav13 client fixture

Exercises core UTF-16 string widths, CHKDATA version results, integer RAND clamps and preset ERD names/prices through the existing client drivers. CSV explicit zero price wins over ERD; the resulting warning is intentional. Input 7 verifies continued operation and repeated RAND entry use. Final runtime identity is checked from the public project report, not script output. Original upstream-7b69 fixture remains independent.
